services.desc: With its unique architecture, blending elements of our area’s rich tobacco history with modern amenities, The Prizery is the perfect place to make your next event one to remember. The Prizery has several unique spaces to help customize your event. From its 250-seat proscenium theater to a large banquet hall, to the art gallery lobby, The Prizery can host a variety of events and assist with audio/visual, and other needs to put the finishing touches on your special occasion. 200+ Capacity Kitchen with Fridges & Freezers Bathrooms on Same Level Elevator Access Download
